mechanism_narrative: A higher level of the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) indicates elevated inflation, which typically leads to tighter monetary policy and reduced equity valuations, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Rank IC between CPIAUCSL and 20-day S&P 500 returns is less than 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained unemployment rate above 5.0% signals a weakening labor market, which typically leads to reduced consumer spending and corporate earnings, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where UNRATE > 5.0, or Rank IC over last 3 years is less than 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A rising unemployment rate (UNRATE) combined with a declining consumer spending (RSAFS) indicates a deteriorating economic outlook, triggering negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In instances where UNRATE rises >0.1pp and RSAFS falls >1%, SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of cases, or Rank IC for interaction term is less than 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary tightening cycle, an increase in the federal funds rate signals reduced liquidity and higher discount rates, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Rank IC between FEDFUNDS and 20-day S&P 500 returns is less than 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window during monetary tightening cycles.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 100 (index base 2017=100) indicates a contraction in the manufacturing sector, which typically leads to reduced corporate profits and negative equity returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where INDPRO < 100, or Rank IC over last 3 years is less than 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A rising trend in housing starts (HOUST) indicates robust economic activity and consumer confidence, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: Rank IC between change in HOUST and 5-day S&P 500 returns is less than 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A deceleration in job growth (PAYEMS) combined with a rising unemployment rate (UNRATE) indicates a deteriorating labor market, which typically leads to reduced consumer spending and negative equity returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In instances where PAYEMS growth slows and UNRATE rises, SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of cases, or Rank IC for interaction term is less than 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A higher level of real GDP (GDPC1) signals robust economic growth, which typically supports corporate earnings and positive equity returns, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Rank IC between GDPC1 and 60-day S&P 500 returns is less than 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
